item.title: Com-Til Compost, Hauler List Info Request
item.description:
We at Com-Til Compost are updating our hauler list. We publish this list on our website, and keep physical copies at our facility. We reference this list to customers that may not have a means to transport the compost or need an amount that does not meet our wholesale account minimum.

If you'd like to join this list, please fill out this form: https://forms.gle/nHb5eFVvdcS2FvU96

We ask for your response by Tuesday, May 13th, 2025.

Thank you!
Com-Til Team
email: comtil@columbus.gov
614-645-3153
